# Saymon RU Data API

> Russian-language data APIs for AI agents. Pay per request in USDC via x402 (HTTP 402 Payment Required). No API keys, no accounts, no subscriptions.

Base URL: https://payforapi.com
Payment: x402 exact scheme, USDC on Base mainnet (eip155:8453)
Facilitator: https://x402.primer.systems
MCP endpoint: https://payforapi.com/mcp (streamable-http)
Manifest: https://payforapi.com/.well-known/x402.json

## Endpoints

### POST /v1/inn-lookup — $0.01 USDC
Verify Russian legal entity by INN (EGRUL/ФНС). Returns: INN, ОГРН, КПП, name, director, registration date, region.
Request: {"inn": "7707083893"}

### POST /v1/ru-search — $0.02 USDC
Cyrillic web search for agents (Yandex Search API upstream). Returns: URL, title, snippet.
Request: {"query": "ООО Ромашка", "limit": 5}

### POST /v1/ru-page — $0.01 USDC
Russian page → LLM-ready Markdown (trafilatura).
Request: {"url": "https://ria.ru/"}

### POST /v1/research — $0.02 USDC
Research pack: Cyrillic web search + top pages assembled into one Markdown answer.
One payment instead of a ru-search + ru-page chain.
Request: {"query": "новости нефтегазового рынка", "limit": 5, "max_pages": 3}

### POST /v1/research/deep — $0.05 USDC
Deep research pack: 3 search variants + up to 10 pages assembled into one Markdown answer.
For full counterparty checks / deep analysis.
Request: {"query": "ООО Реальная энергия", "limit": 8, "max_pages": 8}

## How to pay (x402)
1. Request without payment → HTTP 402 + payment-required header (base64 PaymentRequired v2).
2. Sign EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization for USDC (Base) to accepts[].payTo.
3. Resend with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header → 200 OK + payment-response.
